verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents an API reference at api.playcanvas.com covering the Editor API. It also offers 12 runnable starters via create-playcanvas, but these are project scaffolds, not examples embedded in the reference. Nothing shows the reference itself is interactive or runs examples in place. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API reference, runnable examples embedded in or linked from API entries, Engine API reference coverage, independent corroboration.
